subject: Supplemental SOC 2 artifacts and auth-log window for Type II audit
messages:
From: Lydia Park <l.park@brightwell.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II — supplemental evidence & auth-log window

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the quick call this morning. Brightwell's audit team has one follow-up: aside from the SOC 2 Type II report, they need a few supplemental artifacts to close the authentication controls (CC6/CC7) evidence bucket:

- A bridge letter if the SOC 2 coverage window doesn't exactly match Brightwell's contract period (they prefer explicit confirmation covering 2023-10-01 through 2024-03-31).
- An auth-log slice that contains successful/failed auth events for the audit window (timestamps, user ids, event type, and IP provenance). Preferably in CSV (zipped).
- MFA configuration export (what factors are enforced, policy dates, and enrollment counts) and any recent rotation/change logs for 2024.
- Evidence of quarterly access reviews (names of reviewers, review dates, outcomes).

Please let us know:
1) whether Redwood can provide these artifacts and whether any items will need redaction. Brightwell prefers full timestamps in UTC and hashed IPs if possible.
2) the expected delivery timeline (auditor deadline is 2027-04-30).

If any of this requires a signed NDA/secure transfer channel, say the word and we'll enable it from our side.

Appreciate it —
Lydia
Lydia Park
Senior Compliance Manager
Brightwell Health
l.park@brightwell.com

Attachment: auditor_ask_list_04222027.pdf (stub)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <l.park@brightwell.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:03:45 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — supplemental evidence & auth-log window

Thanks Lydia — we can support these asks. Looping in Naomi (Security Controls) and Priyom (Customer Support/SRE) to coordinate extraction and transfer.

Quick clarifying questions before we start the pull:
- You asked for the window 2023-10-01 through 2024-03-31 — do you require the logs to be inclusive of 2024-03-31 23:59:59 UTC? We typically produce slices inclusive of the end date; confirm preferred time zone (you mentioned UTC which is fine).
- For IPs: we can provide raw IPs over a secure channel or provide SHA-256 hashed IPs. Which do auditors prefer for Brightwell?
- Any PII redaction rules beyond IP hashing (e.g., user email redaction)?

Targeting same-week delivery if we have sign-off on transfer method. We'll provide a secure Drive link and can generate a bridge letter if the SOC coverage window requires it.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 13:38:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — supplemental evidence & auth-log window

Hi Lydia — thanks for the details. We can provide the following artifacts and formats by 2027-04-29:

- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF): SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_2023-10-01_2024-03-31.pdf
- Bridge letter certifying control continuity covering the requested window: bridge_letter_2024-03-31.pdf
- Auth log slice (CSV, zipped): auth_log_slice_202403-20240331.csv.zip — includes UTC timestamps, user_id (internal GUID), event (login_success/login_failure), auth_method, and source_ip.
- MFA configuration export (CSV): mfa_config_export_2024-03-31.csv — lists enabled factors, enforcement date, and enrolled user counts.
- Access review report for Q1 2024 (PDF): access_review_Q1_2024.pdf — reviewer names, dates, and remediation notes.

A few notes and options:
- IPs: by default we'll provide SHA-256 hashed source_ip in the CSV. We can provide unhashed IPs only over an encrypted SFTP transfer and with an executed data handling agreement. Please confirm which you prefer.
- Timestamps: we'll output UTC timestamps per row as you requested.
- Redaction: we do not redact user_id GUIDs (they're internal identifiers), but we can redact email addresses if the auditor requests it. Let us know.

Secure transfer options: Google Drive secure share (link below, permissioned to your compliance mailbox), SFTP with account provisioning, or an encrypted zip via our secure vault (we can provide a DocuSign-secured access request). I have uploaded a proof-of-possession stub to our secure Drive already.

Secure Drive (access restricted): https://drive.google.com/s/secure-share/0Bxyz

If that plan works, we'll begin the extract and deliver by the requested date.

— Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Security Controls
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Naomi / Logan — that plan works. A few quick answers:

- Please include logs inclusive of 2024-03-31 23:59:59 UTC.
- Hashed IPs are acceptable — SHA-256 is preferred. No additional PII redaction needed beyond email redaction if present.
- Secure Drive share is fine; we'll request access from the link you posted. If you add audit-team@brightwell.com to the permission list that covers the auditor.
- Delivery target: 2027-04-29 COB would be ideal (auditor hearing on 2027-04-30).

Thanks for the quick turn — we appreciate it.
